subject: Re: Kickoff: CANN - staffing + data timing
body:
Lucia,

Staffing confirmed: Linnea 70% carrying the implementation, Quentin 50% on the recall/latency methodology, Chiara 50% on data plumbing (feature extraction jobs and the Eigen binary matrix format the index expects - one matrix per image, rows as d-dim vectors), Nikhil 25% TL as you said.

Compute: CPU-heavy indexing, not GPU. I've requested a 64-vCPU pool; the only GPU use is FIRE feature extraction for the internal set, maybe 10 titan-a100 days total.

Heads-up on data timing: the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-24, so our indoor capture set needs to be ingested by mid-July at the latest. That's after our window closes, so ingestion can trail the M3 report without risk - I've sequenced Chiara's tickets accordingly.

One flag: the sample data download comes from an external Drive link; Chiara is mirroring it internally today so CI doesn't depend on it.

Daniela
